notes.title: Bosses Update is Here!
notes.notes:
Hi there!
Bosses update is live now.

What's changed in game:

-We have amazing bosses now.
-Wave count is decreased to 3 from 5 for each level, because some players complained about repetitiveness of the game. That will decrease total game time too, but you can always replay levels.
-Controller support is really full now. Controller navigation in menu is improved. Controller vibration is working now. Game pauses when a controller disconnects.
-Weapon upgrade prices are changed to balance the game.
-Zombies are now appearing at random spawn points by default. You can disable it anytime in the gameplay options menu if you like.
-Fixed some audio bugs. SFX volume now controls UI volume too. Balanced some in-game sound effect levels. Music was stopping when you magnet too many coins in a short time.
-Some other minor fixes.

I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: A Huge Update Is On Its Way!
notes.notes:
Hi there!
I'm working on a huge update where there will be bosses and some other surprises to make the game more fun for everyone.
Did you think Pear Heads, Beauty Marks, Snake Girls and Boys, Shape-Shifters, Half-Werewolfs, Primate-Mans and Glasses Wearing Foxes are only exist in our planet? Oh no, my friends, and you are going to know all about them...
It can take some time around 3 months, so please, hold on!
